recommendation: Keep the source fix. It completes the FHIR-31595 narrative alignment across active resource pages; handle later PaymentNotice editorial and search-parameter ballot issues through their own applied-change workflow.
issue_request: FHIR-31595 asked why PaymentNotice.payment was mandatory when a PaymentReconciliation might not yet exist; FM resolved it as Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6, clarifying PaymentNotice boundary wording and requesting related content review.

additional_context: PaymentNotice and PaymentReconciliation are active in source/fhir.ini. R4 published PaymentNotice.payment as mandatory, while R5 and build.fhir.org show it as optional. No Zulip or Confluence evidence contradicted the Jira/source trail. Later FHIR-53918 is related editorial work in Resolved - change required status and was not decided in this default Applied/Published run.
reconciliation: Updated source/paymentreconciliation/paymentreconciliation-introduction.xml at the PaymentNotice boundary paragraph and eClaim related-resource table to use the same 'payment has been initiated' wording as the PaymentNotice page. No StructureDefinition target change was made because current source already resolves the mandatory-reference concern with 0..1 cardinality and the self-reference target would be a separate semantic expansion.
